title: Engineering half-metallicity in wurtzite Zn1−2xMnxAxS (A = Mo, Ni) for enhanced optoelectronic and thermoelectric performance: a DFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1622-1642
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09710J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
W. Amghar, A. Fakhim Lamrani, K. Sadki, F. E. EL Mabchour, E. Maskar, A. El hat, S. Otmani, R. Ahl Laamara
DFT calculations reveal that (Mn, Mo) and (Mn, Ni) codoped ZnS exhibit artificial half-metallicity driven by p–d hybridization, ferrimagnetic ground-state stabilization, redshifted optical response, and enhanced thermoelectric performance for multifunctional applications.
